description: This PHP class defines a client for the AWS ARC Zonal Shift service, providing methods to interact with various API endpoints related to zonal shifts, such as starting, updating, listing, and canceling zonal shifts, along with other resource management functions.

classes.name: ARCZonalShiftClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS ARC Zonal Shift service, extending the generic AWS client to add specific methods related to zonal shifts.

methods.name: createPracticeRunConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new practice run configuration.

methods.name: deletePracticeRunConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes an existing practice run configuration.

methods.name: getAutoshiftObserverNotificationStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the notification status of the autoshift observer.

methods.name: getManagedResource
methods.description: Gets information about a managed resource.

methods.name: updateAutoshiftObserverNotificationStatus
methods.description: Updates the notification status of the autoshift observer.

methods.name: updatePracticeRunConfiguration
methods.description: Updates an existing practice run configuration.
